Nice comments @samouss 👍 I have a few questions remarks:
 - ok if the the connectPriceRanges makes more let's go for it
 - do you suggest to remove the inputs in the price ranges?
 - ok for changing the name. However I would still alias the new names to the old so that we don't introduce a breaking change here, add a deprecation notice and drop the deprecated names when we move to a new major version.
